'''LargePorg's Friday Night SWCCG''' was the name [[Thomas Santosuosso]] (LargePorg) used for online [[GEMP]] tournaments in [[Premiere - Death Star II]]. He posted them in the Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord channel #friday-night-swccg.<ref name="fn-rules">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1505015808466751518 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (16 May 2026).</ref><ref name="fn-jun5ann">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1512303993768902758 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (5 June 2026).</ref>

On the posted sheets, cstyx is first at 4-0 on 3 July 2026, brb1097 is first at 4-0 on 5 June 2026, and techmo is first at 3-1 on 15 May 2026. [[Thomas Santosuosso|LargePorg]] is also 3-1 on that 15 May sheet, and he named techmo the winner. No winner was posted for 29 May 2026.<ref name="fn-jul">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1522846353665953894 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (4 July 2026). The attached sheet is dated 7-3-2026.</ref><ref name="fn-jun-win">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1512678340044128326 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (6 June 2026).</ref><ref name="fn-jun-sheet">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1512678551860809758 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (6 June 2026).</ref><ref name="fn-may-win">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1505077964440862840 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (16 May 2026).</ref><ref name="fn-may-pdf">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1505076813423050965 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (16 May 2026).</ref><ref name="fn-may29">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1510081879624384774 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (30 May 2026).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] on [[GEMP]]
* The player with the most wins was the formal winner, with strength of schedule.<ref name="fn-rules" /><ref name="fn-jun5ann" />
* Four games, 50 minutes for each round. Players could drop in or drop out, and any [[Premiere - Death Star II]] deck was legal.<ref name="fn-rules" /><ref name="fn-jun5ann" />
* When time expired, the current turn finished through the light side draw phase. Players then totaled reserve, used pile and force pile. The higher total won. If the totals were equal, the player with fewer cards in the lost pile won. The 5 June rules counted lost-pile and out-of-play cards together for that comparison.<ref name="fn-rules" /><ref name="fn-jun5ann" />

LargePorg wrote on 11 May 2026 that he would be hosting on 15 May.<ref name="fn-host15">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1503497877245263902 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (11 May 2026).</ref> The dates he set were 15 May at 10:00 p.m. Eastern and 29 May, for four games of [[Premiere - Death Star II]].<ref name="fn-dates">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1500356850871304342 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (3 May 2026).</ref> LargePorg called the 15 May night a practice run and set the next date as 29 May 2026.<ref name="fn-may-win" /> The 5 June night started just before 9:00 p.m. Eastern.<ref name="fn-jun5ann" /> On 3 July he started the tournament pairings at 9:00 p.m.<ref name="fn-jul-start">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1522722573597544509 LargePorg, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (3 July 2026).</ref>

=== 29 May 2026 ===

No winner was posted for 29 May 2026.<ref name="fn-may29" /> redv asked whether the night should be postponed until more than four people could play.<ref name="fn-redv">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1499993538090373260/1509942502361137272 redv, #friday-night-swccg], Star Wars CCG Retro Club Discord (29 May 2026).</ref> LargePorg wrote that he would play his league match at 9:00 p.m. and then see who was around for [[Premiere - Death Star II]].<ref name="fn-may29" />
